about: Recall quality cases. Vectors are from bge-small-en-v1.5 int8 (the model Winku downloads), one text at a time; queries carry the bge query prefix. Regenerate them with the real model if the notes or messages change.

notes.title: Release checklist
notes.body: Bump versions in three places, tag, then let the release workflow sign and upload the installers.

notes.title: Prefers WebP at quality 82
notes.body: Screenshots for the blog go out as WebP at quality 82, 1600 px wide.

notes.title: Coffee
notes.body: Oat milk, no sugar. Decaf after four.

notes.title: Fixing the AltGr hotkeys
notes.body: Worked out why Ctrl+Alt keys type characters on Polish layouts and moved the defaults.

notes.title: Porto in December
notes.body: Train from Lisbon on the 12th, back on the 15th. Wants a quiet place near the river.

notes.title: Winku 0.2 scope
notes.body: Memory first: profile, goals and recap in every prompt, notes recalled by meaning.

notes.title: Code review on Thursdays
notes.body: Reviews the week's PRs on Thursday mornings, before standup.

notes.title: Prefers small PRs
notes.body: One change per PR, with screenshots for anything visible.

notes.title: Tauri window flags
notes.body: Transparent windows on Windows need the shadow turned off or a border shows.

notes.title: ONNX Runtime linking
notes.body: Links ORT statically from the sherpa build so there is one copy of the library.

notes.title: Clippy before pushing
notes.body: Runs cargo clippy with warnings as errors before every push.

notes.title: Half marathon in March
notes.body: Lisbon half on March 15. Long run on Sundays, up to 18 km by February.

notes.title: Knee after long runs
notes.body: Left knee aches after anything over 15 km; ices it and skips hills the next day.

notes.title: Morning runs before work
notes.body: Runs at 7, before the first call, along the river.

notes.title: Pastel de nata
notes.body: Buys them from the bakery on the corner on Saturday mornings.

notes.title: No coffee after four
notes.body: Caffeine late keeps them up; switches to decaf after 4pm.

notes.title: Biscuit's walk at six
notes.body: The dog needs a walk at 6pm; the river path is the usual route.

notes.title: Biscuit's vet in January
notes.body: Annual checkup and vaccines due in the second week of January.

notes.title: Window seat on trains
notes.body: Books a window seat facing forward on the Lisbon to Porto train.

notes.title: Before and after in PRs
notes.body: PRs that change UI get before and after screenshots at desktop and mobile sizes.
